args.prompt: Leap on 'fast', crowd jumps on each hit. FAST on the left half in hot saturated color, leaping off the car hood toward camera, the crowd behind him jumping with fists raised. Camera: Low wide, FAST mid-air. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, dusk under a highway overpass, sodium light, film grain, VHS softness. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
